WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    c.id,
    c.status,
    c.created_at,
    c.converted_at,
    c.abandoned_at,
    c.expires_at,
    CASE
      WHEN c.converted_at IS NOT NULL OR c.abandoned_at IS NOT NULL OR c.expires_at IS NOT NULL
      THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(c.converted_at, c.abandoned_at, c.expires_at) - c.created_at)) / 3600.0
      ELSE NULL
    END AS resolution_hours
  FROM carts c
  JOIN tenants t ON t.id = c.tenant_id
  WHERE t.name IN ('Kibblewick', 'Studio Vrij', 'Petalcourt Beauty', 'Marrowby & Vane', 'Cragsley Outfitters', 'Ampfeld Elektronik')
    AND c.created_at >= DATE '2025-10-01'
    AND c.created_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
),
bucketed AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN resolution_hours IS NULL THEN 'unresolved/still active'
      WHEN resolution_hours < 1 THEN '<1 hour'
      WHEN resolution_hours < 24 THEN '1-24 hours'
      WHEN resolution_hours < 168 THEN '1-7 days'
      ELSE '>7 days'
    END AS duration_bucket
  FROM base
)
SELECT
  duration_bucket,
  COUNT(*) AS cart_count,
  ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 1) AS pct_of_carts,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'converted' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 1) AS converted_pct
FROM bucketed
GROUP BY duration_bucket
ORDER BY
  CASE duration_bucket
    WHEN '<1 hour' THEN 1
    WHEN '1-24 hours' THEN 2
    WHEN '1-7 days' THEN 3
    WHEN '>7 days' THEN 4
    WHEN 'unresolved/still active' THEN 5
  END
note: Resolution time = coalesce(converted_at, abandoned_at, expires_at) - created_at, computed in hours; carts with all three null fall into the 'unresolved/still active' bucket. Tenant names matched exactly as given against tenants.name.
